column3: Close to the Hebrew; זְמָן (“a season”) is rendered “a season,” and “matter” “purpose.”
Close to the Hebrew; “to bear [a child]” is rendered “to be born.”
Close to the Hebrew; “to seek… to count as lost” is rendered “to gain… to lose.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the task which God has given” is rendered “the God-given task.”
Close to the Hebrew; הָעֹלָם (“eternity”) is rendered “eternity.”
Close to the Hebrew; “God seeks what was pursued” is rendered “God requires an account of what is past.”
Close to the Hebrew; the second “wickedness” is rendered “Iniquity.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “like,” “they themselves are like animals.”
Close to the Hebrew; “futility” is rendered “vanity.”
Close to the Hebrew; “his portion” is rendered “his heritage.”
